title: Same Count, Different History: Hidden-Height Operators, Shifted Legendre Horizons, and Euler-Bernoulli Cantilever Spectra in Permutation Random Walks (Research in Progress v0.1)
description: Working paper (Research in Progress v0.1) investigating non-Markovian memory in the odd-step sign sequence of permutation random walks (following Wenpin Tang, arXiv:2609.25102v1). Although the cumulative count A_n of positive odd heights matches Polya's urn in all 1D and adjacent-pair marginals, full sign histories exhibit rich analytic structure governed by a piecewise differential-difference operator on unit intervals, shifted Legendre polynomial projections (exact m-step horizon at degree D = 2m), the 4th-order Euler-Bernoulli cantilever beam eigenvalue equation cosh(k)cos(k) = -1, Wiener-Hopf ladder-height cumulants, Bell-polynomial parity duality, and a 2x2 Cauchy-Binet Gram-turn determinant.
